title: Blake Snell Injured During Dodgers Game, Postseason Status Uncertain
summary: Pitcher Blake Snell exited a game early due to a left groin injury, raising concerns about his availability for the Dodgers' postseason. The severity of the injury and its potential impact on his participation in the upcoming playoffs remain unclear. Snell's performance has been a key factor for the team.
summary_points: Blake Snell exited a game early due to a left groin injury.
The injury has raised concerns about his availability for the Dodgers' postseason.
The severity of the injury and its impact on his playoff participation are currently uncertain.
